{n} said, "The whole neighborhood knows. I may have told them. Several times."
{n} said, "{amt}. I raised a mogul. I actually raised a mogul."
{n} said, "Promise me you'll stay humble. And promise me you're paying for Thanksgiving this year."

{n} said, "{amt}. I had to look up how many zeros that is."
{n} said, "You're not going to forget about us little people, right? Right?"

{n} raised a glass. "{amt}. You did good. You're catching up to us. We knew you had it in you, {kid}."

{n} said, "We knew you had it in you, {kid}. We just didn't think you had THIS much in you."
